updates.title: Anthropic's Claude is down... again
updates.summary: Claude suffered a major worldwide outage on July 29-30, 2026, driven by two consecutive network failures that slashed capacity across claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork, producing mass 529 Overloaded errors that hit users mid-task starting around 19:45 UTC. Anthropic identified the issue by 8:33 PM UTC and confirmed full recovery by late July 30, though Claude for Government remained unaffected throughout due to its isolated infrastructure. The word 'again' in the headline signals a recurring reliability problem — 2026 has seen multiple high-profile Claude outages, reinforcing growing concerns about platform stability for professional and enterprise users.
updates.accuracy_notes: Outage confirmed independently by Bleeping Computer ('Anthropic Confirms Claude is Down Worldwide'), Newsweek, Glitchwire, and multiple user-community threads (DesignTAXI, Claude Status). The July 29-30 timeline and 529 error details are consistent across all sources. Direct article fetch was blocked (HTTP 403); date and content corroborated via web search. The 'again' framing is editorially accurate — Claude experienced separate outages in January 2026 and July 9, 2026 as well.
